name: InvokeWebServiceNode
label: HTTP Request
description: Sends an HTTP request to a RESTful web service and returns the response body, status code, and headers.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: EndpointUrl
fields.label: Endpoint URL
fields.description: The full URL of the web service endpoint. Must include the scheme (e.g., 'https://api.example.com/v1/users').

fields.name: HttpMethod
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.description: The HTTP verb for the request. Defaults to GET.

selectOptions.label: GET
selectOptions.description: Retrieves data from the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: POST
selectOptions.description: Submits data to be processed to the specified resource.

selectOptions.label: PUT
selectOptions.description: Updates a current resource with new data.

selectOptions.label: PATCH
selectOptions.description: Applies partial modifications to a resource.

fields.name: RequestBody
fields.label: Request Body
fields.description: The body payload for POST, PUT, or PATCH requests. Ignored for GET and DELETE. Example: '{"name":"John","age":30}'.

fields.name: ContentType
fields.label: Content Type
fields.description: The MIME type of the request body. Defaults to 'application/json'. Common values: 'application/json', 'text/xml', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

fields.name: AcceptHeader
fields.label: Accept Header
fields.description: The MIME type expected in the response. Defaults to 'application/json'. Common values: 'application/json', 'text/xml', 'text/plain'.

fields.name: AuthenticationType
fields.label: Authentication Type
fields.description: The authentication scheme to use. Set to 'None' for unauthenticated requests. Defaults to None.

selectOptions.label: Basic
selectOptions.description: Uses Basic authentication with username and password.

selectOptions.label: Bearer
selectOptions.description: Uses Bearer token authentication for OAuth 2.0.

fields.name: Username
fields.label: Username
fields.description: The username for HTTP Basic authentication. Required when Authentication Type is 'Basic'.

fields.name: Password
fields.label: Password
fields.description: The password for HTTP Basic authentication. Required when Authentication Type is 'Basic'.

fields.name: BearerToken
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.description: The OAuth 2.0 bearer token (without the 'Bearer ' prefix). Required when Authentication Type is 'Bearer'.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to respond before aborting. Defaults to 60. Set to 0 for infinite timeout.

fields.name: UseDefaultCredentials
fields.label: Use Default Credentials
fields.description: When true, sends the current Windows user's credentials (NTLM/Kerberos) with the request. Defaults to false.

fields.name: IgnoreSslErrors
fields.label: Ignore SSL Errors
fields.description: When true, bypasses SSL/TLS certificate validation errors (e.g., self-signed certificates). Use only in development environments. Defaults to false.

fields.name: Headers
fields.label: Custom Headers
fields.description: Additional HTTP headers to include in the request as key-value pairs. Example: { "X-Api-Key": "abc123", "X-Correlation-Id": "uuid" }.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Response Body
fields.description: The response from the web service. Returns a JsonNode if the response is valid JSON, otherwise returns the raw string.

fields.name: ResponseCode
fields.label: Response Code
fields.description: The HTTP status code returned by the server (e.g., 200 for OK, 404 for Not Found).

fields.name: ResponseHeaders
fields.label: Response Headers
fields.description: All response headers returned by the server as key-value pairs.
